title: Command (verb) display and rhythmic intermission
description: The single giant imperative verb shown at microgame start, plus the cognitive-buffer intermission between microgames, hooked into the sequencer lifecycle. Follows unity-microgame-framework and the GDD UI guidance.
acceptance_criteria: A command display shows one large, high-legibility imperative verb (e.g. '¡ESQUIVA!') at microgame start for roughly one second.
An intermission screen plays between microgames as a cognitive buffer with a configurable duration.
Intermission timing is testable in pure C# (a timer/state machine separate from rendering).
Both are driven by the sequencer lifecycle, not hardcoded per microgame.
